group: Message.removeRecord – header is null leads to NPE

cases.expected: NullPointerException – after successful List.remove, header.decCount(section) is invoked on a null header, causing NPE
cases.description: Ensures that the method propagates a NullPointerException when the Message's header field is null and a removal would otherwise succeed.
The internal `sections` array of the Message instance is deliberately set to null. Accessing `sections[section]` triggers a NullPointerException before any null‑check or removal logic is executed.

The target section contains an unmodifiable list (e.g., `Collections.unmodifiableList`). When `removeRecord` attempts `sections[section].remove(r)`, the list throws `UnsupportedOperationException`. The method should not catch it, so the exception propagates.

A mock `Header` object is injected whose `decCount(int)` method deliberately throws `IllegalArgumentException`. After a successful `remove` (the record exists in the list), `removeRecord` calls `header.decCount(section)`, which propagates the exception.
